heading: 6.1.7 Conversion of Water Right Classification
credit: Source: 2026 Rio Grande Regional Water Plan (Region M), Sec. 6.1.7 (TCEQ rules)

paragraphs.text: This strategy involves converting irrigation water rights to municipal water rights as land is converted from agricultural and rural uses to urban uses.

The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) rules establish conversion ratios of 2 acre-feet (ac-ft) of Class A irrigation water rights and 2.5 ac-ft Class B water rights to 1 ac-ft of municipal water rights.
